# Written from Apple's public notes on iCloud Mail settings, not recorded from a real account.
# iCloud needs an app-specific password; the greeting and ID response are typical, not exact.
S: * OK [CAPABILITY IMAP4rev1 AUTH=PLAIN ID IDLE NAMESPACE UIDPLUS LITERAL+ MOVE] iCloud IMAP ready
C: <tag> ID ("name" "lazymail")
S: * ID ("name" "iCloud Mail")
S: <tag> OK ID completed.
C: <tag> LOGIN "user@icloud.example" "abcd-efgh-ijkl-mnop"
S: <tag> OK LOGIN completed.
C: <tag> LIST "" "*"
S: * LIST (\HasNoChildren) "/" "INBOX"
S: * LIST (\HasNoChildren \Sent) "/" "Sent Messages"
S: * LIST (\HasNoChildren \Drafts) "/" "Drafts"
S: * LIST (\HasNoChildren \Trash) "/" "Deleted Messages"
S: * LIST (\HasNoChildren \Junk) "/" "Junk"
S: * LIST (\HasNoChildren \Archive) "/" "Archive"
S: <tag> OK LIST completed.
C: <tag> UID MOVE 12 Archive
S: * OK [COPYUID 3 12 5] Copied
S: * 4 EXPUNGE
S: <tag> OK UID MOVE completed.
